scope: source-first River Fish intake; four seasonal Fish selected by CG-64, Shad/Catfish by CG-65, Walleye and Sunny Sunfish/Rainbow Trout by CG-66/67

source_facts.fact: Chub is catchable in the Cindersap Forest River in every season, at any time and in any weather. It is not a Pelican Town river fish.
Smallmouth Bass is catchable in the Pelican Town river in Spring and Fall, at any time and in any weather; the Cindersap Forest location is its pond.
Pike is catchable in the town or forest river in Summer and Winter, at any time and in any weather.
Perch is catchable in the town or forest river in Winter, at any time and in any weather.
Shad is catchable in the river during Spring, Summer and Fall in Rain, from 9am to 2am.
Catfish is catchable in the river during Spring and Fall in Rain, from 6am to midnight. Summer Secret Woods and Winter Rain Totem exceptions are separate source locations/conditions.
Walleye is catchable in the river in Fall Rain from 12pm to 2am; Winter requires a Rain Totem. It is described as a night fish.
Sunfish is catchable in the river from 6am to 7pm in Spring and Summer in Sun or Wind weather. Tutorial and Magic Bait exceptions are outside the ordinary river pool.
Rainbow Trout is catchable in the river from 6am to 7pm in Summer in Sun weather. Trout Derby and Magic Bait are separate exceptions.

source_facts.fact: CG-24 already supplies three visually identical Fishing Spot instances with hidden 25/50/75 success odds, one 1 AP Cast per spot per day and Sleep refresh. Silver Minnow is the original Fish output.

adaptation.label: CG-64–67 family-level paper adaptation; source locations and hours compressed into the LVC River Region and four forward-only phases
adaptation.result: success yields exactly one Fish Item; No Bite yields none; spot spent either way
adaptation.output_selection: On success only, draw uniformly and independently from eligible Fish identities filtered by Season, Today Weather and current phase; on No Bite draw no identity. Spot success odds and hidden assignment are unchanged.
adaptation.time_window_rule: CG-66 uses Morning -> Noon -> Afternoon -> Night, advanced manually and only forward with a 0 AP Next Phase control. Walleye is Noon/Afternoon/Night; Sunfish and Rainbow Trout are Morning/Noon/Afternoon; broad Shad/Catfish source windows are compressed to all four phases.
adaptation.notes: Uniform identity draw and phase compression are LVC paper rules, not Stardew catch rates or exact hours. No Fish is tied to a Fishing Spot tier. River compresses Town/Forest River. Wind, Trout Derby, Winter Rain Totem, price, quality, recipes and other uses are deferred.
